# rapidyaml 0.16.0

The private YAML parser is based on the upstream `rapidyaml.v0.16.0.singlehdr.ints.hpp` release asset (SHA-256 `95d579c6f8d722f7ce39b56007d87cbfa0eb69407064fbcc43ee38b6aff5782e`) and the upstream [`event_handler_ints.hpp`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/biojppm/rapidyaml/v0.16.0/src_extra/c4/yml/extra/event_handler_ints.hpp) (SHA-256 `a2c7e3cccec7dde9cc11d2f806ef500ae6481a6ca9ad294b2fc4d0d1dbf24ac1`). Tag `v0.16.0` points to `be65769eb0a50d9a468e52b3b354b8fc4fe1152d`. The patched combined header has SHA-256 `46049a8c2f8cb53726d12c452e64ef5bd29d818cff22fa07040225a4c0e1b558`. The [MIT license](../../docs/licenses/rapidyaml.txt) and [bundled notices](../../docs/licenses/rapidyaml-bundled.txt) are distributed.

The release asset omitted its required event-handler header; the exact upstream header is inserted at its marked error. The local patch removes `noexcept` from the two event-handler constructors because their stack initialization can allocate, and guards the GNU-only polyfill with `defined` checks for MSVC. The host supplies private bounded allocator/error callbacks and enables tab tokens and tag resolution. Its remaining scalar/key/alias and capacity behavior is implemented by the DxUi adapter. Native qualification and complete conformance evidence remain open.
